# v1.8.0 — Queue freeze recovery, Odesli cross-platform lookup, library gap detection

This release is a defence-in-depth pass on the queue, plus a new way to bring cross-platform links into MeedyaDL and an early version of the Library Scan gap-fill UX. 10 issues fully closed.

## What's new

- **Cross-platform URL lookup via Odesli (song.link).** Paste any Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube, Tidal, Deezer, SoundCloud or Bandcamp link and MeedyaDL can resolve the matching Apple Music entry. Currently surfaced as a backend service ahead of the M9/M10 service rollout — frontend UX lands in a follow-up. (closes #295)
- **Library Scan: enrichment gap detection.** The Library Scan page now flags album folders that are missing expected sidecars (LRC / VTT / SRT / animated artwork / cover) or codec variants, so you can re-queue the gaps in one click. Phase 1 MVP — the row-level diff UI lands in a follow-up. (closes #759)

## What's fixed

- **Queue no longer freezes on a stuck filesystem.** The post-companion "Applying [Explicit]/[Clean] suffixes…" stage is now time-bounded by a 5-minute deadline. If a slow network share, a disconnected cloud mount, or a pathological directory tree hangs the recursive walk, MeedyaDL warns once in the activity log and moves on instead of silently stalling the entire queue. The visible symptom this fixes was "stuck at 95% for hours after 'all codecs exhausted', no log lines, no progress" on a 220-item run. Already-completed renames are preserved on disk — the next run picks up where this one left off. (closes #815)
- **External queue watchdog.** A new top-level safety net polls every active item every 60 s and recovers any item whose progress signal hasn't changed for 10 min (warning) or 20 min (auto-transition to Error so the queue slot is released). Catches stuck downloads regardless of root cause — even when the per-item heartbeat dies with its parent task. (closes #818)
- **Status bar now distinguishes "downloading" from "processing".** Instead of a single lumped counter, the status bar shows two chips: a blue pulsing "● N downloading" for items actively in GAMDL, and an amber "● N processing" for items past the GAMDL exit and in post-companion / enrichment / final-tag stages. You can tell at a glance whether an item is genuinely working or stuck mid-finalisation. (closes #817)
- **Companion final-tag pass no longer rewrites unrelated folders.** The post-companion advisory rename is now correctly scoped to the album directory of the current download rather than the whole output root, preventing collateral renames on neighbouring albums. (closes #816)
- **Dependency on `meedya-core` is now stable on fresh clones.** Pinned to a specific commit rather than a branch ref that was later deleted upstream, so `cargo build` succeeds on a freshly-cloned repo. (closes #352, #353, #596)

## Performance

- **Filesystem-safety audit v1** catalogued every rename / write / copy site across the codebase as the precondition for follow-up hardening work — 14 rename, 129 write, 8 copy. No behaviour change in this release; the audit is the precondition for the wider-scope fixes coming in later versions. (#487)

## Notes

- **Apple Music Radio show URLs (`/station/.../ra.*`)** are blocked on upstream GAMDL accepting station URLs. Phase 0 audit completed; tracker comment lives on #804.
- **MeedyaSuite-core verification rule** added internally: dependency checks against the shared core go via the online repo, never local checkouts. Prevents the class of "works on my machine" failures we hit in the v1.6 cycle.
